PRIVACY

Privacy policy

Effective 4 October 2026

In short:

  • We only collect what we need to answer your enquiry and arrange your journey.
  • In the BYJH app, your preferences and saved journeys stay on your phone. We only receive your details when you send us a journey request.
  • We don’t sell your information, show you adverts, or track you across other apps or websites.
  • You can ask us to see, correct or delete your information at any time by emailing info@byjh.co.uk.

Who we are

This policy explains how BYJH (“we”, “us”) handles personal information when you use our website, www.byjh.co.uk, and the BYJH app for iPhone. BYJH is the controller of this information under the UK General Data Protection Regulation (UK GDPR) and the Data Protection Act 2018.

If you have any questions about this policy or your information, email us at info@byjh.co.uk.

The BYJH app

Information that stays on your phone

When you set up the app, you can tell us your first name, the occasions you travel for, your usual party size and the ambience you prefer. The app also keeps a list of journeys you’ve planned. All of this is stored only on your phone so the app can personalise what you see. It isn’t sent to us, and we can’t see it.

To remove it, delete the app from your phone.

Information you send us

When you send a journey request from the app, we receive:

  • your name, email address and, if you give it, your phone number
  • the journey details: the vehicle, pickup and destination, date and time, number of passengers, and any note you add

Your request is delivered to our team by email so we can confirm availability, give you a price and arrange your chauffeur.

What the app doesn’t do

The app contains no advertising, no third-party analytics and no tracking. It doesn’t access your location, contacts, photos or camera. Its map of London is built into the app from OpenStreetMap data, so viewing it doesn’t share anything with a map provider.

Our website

Contact form

When you send an enquiry through our contact page, we receive your name, email address, phone number if you give it, the type of enquiry, any journey details you add and your message. It is delivered to our team by email so we can reply.

Visitor statistics

We use Vercel Web Analytics to understand how many people visit our website and which pages are popular. It doesn’t use cookies and doesn’t identify you. We see totals only: page views, the pages visited, the website that referred you, and the type of device (for example, mobile or desktop).

Cookies

Our public website doesn’t set cookies. A sign-in cookie is used only on our private staff area, to keep BYJH staff signed in.

Links to other sites

Our website and app link to our Instagram page. If you follow that link, Instagram’s own privacy policy applies.

How we use your information

We use the information you send us to:

  • reply to your enquiry and arrange, confirm and price your journey or custom build (our lawful basis is taking steps at your request before entering into a contract, and performing that contract)
  • keep business and accounting records (to meet our legal obligations, and in our legitimate interest of running our business)
  • understand how our website is used, using anonymous totals only (our legitimate interest in improving our website)

We don’t use your information for automated decision-making or profiling. We won’t send you marketing unless you’ve asked us to.

Who we share it with

We don’t sell or rent your personal information. We share it only with service providers that help us run BYJH, under contracts that require them to protect it and use it only on our instructions:

  • Vercel: hosts our website and provides anonymous visitor statistics
  • Resend: delivers enquiries and journey requests to our team by email
  • our email provider, which stores the emails we receive and send

We may also share information where the law requires it, or with the chauffeur and partners involved in delivering your journey, only as far as needed to carry it out.

International transfers

Some of our service providers may process information outside the UK, for example in the United States. Where they do, we rely on appropriate safeguards recognised under UK law, such as the UK International Data Transfer Addendum or the UK–US data bridge.

How long we keep it

We keep enquiries and journey requests for as long as we need them to handle your enquiry and booking. After that, we keep booking records for up to six years to meet our accounting and legal obligations, and then delete them. Enquiries that don’t lead to a booking are deleted when we no longer need them.

Your rights

Under UK data protection law, you have the right to:

  • ask for a copy of the information we hold about you
  • ask us to correct information that is wrong or incomplete
  • ask us to delete your information
  • object to, or ask us to restrict, how we use your information
  • ask us to transfer your information to you or another organisation

To make any of these requests, including asking us to delete your information, email info@byjh.co.uk. We’ll respond within one month.

Children

Our website and app are not intended for anyone under 18, and we don’t knowingly collect information from children.

Keeping your information safe

Information sent from our website and app is encrypted in transit. Access to enquiries is limited to the BYJH team who need it to handle your booking.

Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time. We’ll post the new version on this page and change the effective date at the top.

Complaints

If you’re unhappy with how we’ve handled your information, please contact us first at info@byjh.co.uk and we’ll do our best to put it right. You also have the right to complain to the Information Commissioner’s Office (ICO) at ico.org.uk.
